components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:var(--font);font-size:13px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 14px;min-height:35px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(#378bff,#1267e6);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #ffffff99,0 3px 8px #1e71ef29}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#1964d8;border-color:#1964d8}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-primary:disabled{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 35%,var(--line));border-color:transparent;opacity:.7;box-shadow:none;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none;animation:none}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Standard Open card, Backup, and Sync control; quiet disabled state.
components.html: <button class="ds-secondary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19.6 12a7.6 7.6 0 1 1-2.2-5.4M19.6 5.4v5h-5"/></svg>Sync</button>
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:var(--font);font-size:13px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 14px;min-height:35px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease;background:var(--panel-strong);color:var(--text);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8) inset,var(--shadow-tile)}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){color:var(--accent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 35%,var(--line))}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-secondary:disabled{color:var(--text-faint);box-shadow:none;cursor:default}.ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.ds-secondary svg{flex-shrink:0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none;animation:none}}

components.name: Danger button
components.html: <button class="ds-danger" disabled title="Delete save is not available yet">Delete save</button>
components.css: .ds-danger{font-family:var(--font);font-size:13px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 14px;min-height:35px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease;padding:8px;min-height:40px;color:var(--danger);background:transparent;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--danger) 35%,white);box-shadow:none}.ds-danger:hover:not(:disabled){color:var(--accent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 35%,var(--line))}.ds-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-danger:disabled{color:var(--text-faint);border-color:var(--line);cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-danger{transition:none;animation:none}}

components.name: Empty block tile
components.description: A visible numbered empty physical block; never omitted.
components.css: .ds-tile{position:relative;width:150px;min-height:176px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--panel-strong) 40%,transparent);color:var(--text-faint);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-md)}.ds-tile-hit{font-family:var(--font);font-size:13px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;min-height:176px;padding:12px 8px 14px;background:transparent;color:inherit;border:0;border-radius:12px;cursor:default}.ds-index{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;color:var(--text);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-well{display:block;width:80px;height:80px;border:2px dashed #acbdcd;border-radius:var(--radius-well)}.ds-tile:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 35%,var(--line))}.ds-tile-hit:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:-3px}

narrative.overview:
A light desktop manager built around the physical geometry of a PS1 memory card. Cool paper, frost surfaces, fine navy rules, and small inset highlights make the controls feel tangible without overpowering the save icons. The existing world remains The Cool Paper Desk.

The final mock supplies the grouped source sidebar, inset card summary, five-column block gallery, adjacent inspector, and quiet footer. The implementation retains that material and spacing hierarchy while following PRODUCT.md for real card contents and available operations. System UI type keeps metadata compact; Encode Sans Expanded identifies the product only in the top-left wordmark.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper and layered frost materials.
Fifteen numbered blocks with crisp pixel wells.
One action blue with small semantic status accents.
Compact metadata and restrained, tactile controls.

rules.name: The Blue Selection Rule
rules.body: Selection, chain focus, occupied blocks, progress, and the primary action share Manager Blue. Occupancy Gold identifies only the focused chain in the occupancy strip.

rules.name: The Compact Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Reserve Encode Sans Expanded for the top-left memcard-viewer wordmark; use the body stack for task headings and metadata.

rules.name: The Soft Depth Rule
rules.body: Use the named inset-highlight and diffuse navy shadow vocabulary; do not introduce hard offset shadows.

dos: Do keep all fifteen numbered tiles in physical slot order, including empty tiles and non-contiguous continuation blocks.
Do retain the same save icon and an n of m caption on continuation tiles.
Do render real 16×16 save frames with pixelated scaling in the near-black well.
Do use actual save and occupied-block counts; a multi-block save is one save.
Do keep unavailable actions visible, disabled, and titled “{feature} is not available yet”.
Do preserve the top-left PlayStation monogram beside memcard-viewer as the only brand lockup.
donts: Don’t use charcoal slabs, CRT or XMB styling, or PlayStation red as the action accent.
Don’t copy the mock’s second hardware slot, fictitious collection counts, or two-way sync claims; hardware exposes one slot and auto-backup remains unavailable. Manual Sync is card-to-directory only.
Don’t add Sony branding to the card plate or a second PlayStation Memory Card Manager lockup.
Don’t treat synthetic development fixture icons as production artwork or substitute mock illustrations for parsed save icons.
Don’t hide empty or continuation blocks, rearrange physical slots to group a chain, or smooth pixel art.
